headline: India exceeded expectations at the 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, bringing home 39 medals across athletics, shooting, wrestling and more, marking a historic performance for the nation.
The India women's cricket team secured a berth for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics after winning the decisive series against their opponents, confirming India's spot at the upcoming Games.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi announced a nationwide talent hunt for children aged 5‑15 on Independence Day, aiming to build a pipeline of athletes for the 2036 Olympic Games.
